_readme: Reconstructed format, same convention as team-health-analyzer. No external dependencies, no network calls. The capability to actually PAUSE a workflow depends on an unconfirmed RailCall feature -- see workflows/budget-guardian/README.md. This module only decides WHAT to pause, it doesn't execute it.
description: Tracks RailCall workflows' spend against a cap, and decides when and who to pause. Pure logic, no external dependencies.

actions.name: should_pause_workflows
actions.note: Decides WHAT to pause. Actually executing the pause depends on an unconfirmed RailCall capability.
